title: On rigidity of Finsler manifolds without conjugate points and with constant $S$-curvature
summary: We study rigidity phenomena in closed Finsler manifolds without conjugate points under assumptions on the $S$-curvature. We prove that a closed $C^ω$ Finsler manifold with constant $S$-curvature, continuous Green bundles, and admitting a hyperbolic closed geodesic must be Riemannian. In the $C^\infty$ setting, the same conclusion holds under the additional assumption that the geodesic flow is transitive.
